subject.title: Workspaces: add version history and exact restore

question: Should Workspaces version history ship with these three general synchronous Kysely helpers as permanent public plugin SDK exports, or must the storage seam be narrowed before merge?
rationale: The feature is new user-facing product surface and the implementation expands a compatibility-sensitive public SDK; tests cannot determine the intended long-term API boundary.

options.title: Approve a narrower SDK seam
options.body: Keep the Workspaces feature but replace the three general helpers with the smallest purpose-specific plugin-state contract that satisfies this store.

options.title: Accept the proposed exports
options.body: Treat the three synchronous Kysely helpers as supported third-party plugin API and retain the accompanying documentation and baseline changes.

options.title: Pause the feature
options.body: Leave version history unmerged until the broader Workspaces roadmap and storage API direction are explicitly sponsored.

recommendation.title: Approve a narrower SDK seam
recommendation.body: Keep the Workspaces feature but replace the three general helpers with the smallest purpose-specific plugin-state contract that satisfies this store.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice concerns supported plugin SDK and product surface rather than a mechanical branch repair.
